stage: V11.4 Short-Term Catalyst Intelligence rule freeze
reason_for_redesign: V11.0-V11.3 still relied too heavily on already-public price momentum and shallow event labels. The target is causal, early transformation discovery.
objective: Discover under-recognized transformation stories with primary emphasis on 2x within 6 months.
mandatory_changes: Create a multi-source document/evidence layer independent of price.
Link company -> product -> end-market/theme -> demand accelerator -> company catalyst -> expected financial impact.
Separate announced capacity from funded, under-construction, trial, commissioned, commercial-production and utilisation-ramp stages.
Estimate catalyst magnitude relative to company scale, not binary event presence.
Estimate order probability using L1/shortlist/vendor approval/customer tender/LOA/purchase order stages; rumours alone cannot qualify.
Parse promoter purchases by transaction quality and combine with persistent accumulation rather than one-day volume spikes.
Extract point-in-time numeric fundamentals from NSE integrated financial XBRL.
Use primary-source trust, corroboration, freshness and contradiction penalties.
Apply explicit already-priced-in penalty from the first catalyst timestamp.
V10.2 can confirm a story but cannot create eligibility.
horizon_rationale: Short-term turnaround is the target. Six-month outcomes dominate model selection; twelve-month outcomes provide secondary evidence; twenty-four-month outcomes carry only a small fallback weight and must not rescue weak short-term candidates.
freeze_note: Horizon weights updated before V11.4 historical validation. No V11.4 historical backtest result had been used to choose these weights.
